thread:
nora_csm: HelixAI asked for an EU-only short-lived proxy allowlist and a temporary QPS bump for a partner demo next Fri. Renewal touchpoint in 10 days, they said demo quality is a make-or-break. Need ops + SRE to confirm safe limits and auto-revoke.

kai_sre: Can you share the proxy header/cidrs, exact target QPS, and demo window? Also whether they're on Hosted or Dedicated.

nora_csm: Header: X-Proxy-Client: helix-partner; CIDR: 18.184.0.0/16 (partner CDN).
Current steady RPS ~450. Request: burst to 1400 rps (soft), hard-throttle 1800.
Window: 2026-04-16T08:00Z -> 2026-04-18T20:00Z
Tenant: hosted (org: helix-prod)
Note: EU-only routing preferred (eu-west1), short TTL, auto-revoke.

jamal_sales: Renewal risk = HIGH until demo passes. Finance wants auto-notify if soft ceiling breached. I'm adding a renewal note.

kai_sre: Plan: create header-allow entry + per-org rate policy with soft+hard caps. Route prefer eu-west1, fallback eu-central1. KV priming for top-40 prefixes 30m before start. TTL 72h. Name: helix-demo-eu-347210. I'll draft rollback steps.

pat_ops: Internal commands to apply:
```
redwood-admin header-allow add --name helix-demo-eu-347210 \
  --header "X-Proxy-Client:helix-partner" \
  --cidr 18.184.0.0/16 \
  --org helix-prod \
  --ttl 72h --auto-revoke

redwood-admin rate set --org helix-prod \
  --soft-ceiling 1400 --hard-throttle 1800 \
  --region-preference eu-west1 --fallback eu-central1
```
config-bot: header-allow created (id: hla-90512). rate policy applied (rp-80421). start=2026-04-16T08:00Z end=2026-04-18T20:00Z. links: https://internal.redwood/allowlists/hla-90512 https://internal.redwood/policies/rp-80421

nora_csm: Great, please add dashboard watch and alert me + @jamal_sales at 75% of the soft ceiling. Attach the rollback playbook to the allowlist page and note estimated cost delta (~+12%).

kai_sre: Watch added: dashboard/helix-prod/throughput -> alert @nora_csm @jamal_sales at 75% soft. Rollback steps attached. Also added autoscale hint for eu fleet.

pat_ops: Scheduling KV warmup job 30m prior and will include a 2-line runbook for on-call.

nora_csm: I'll notify the customer with start/end, auto-revoke, and monitoring plan. Will post a +1h usage snapshot when the demo starts. :thumbsup:
